lines: Someday, skimming just above our heads,
that plane that passed on by—
strangely enough, I still remember it
though it meant nothing, somehow
On the night of the day I cried, feeling useless,
I just wished I could be strong
and the courage I'd need for that
was what I searched for
Even if a cruel fate has already been decided,
even if it appears before me someday,
if only for one instant, this one instant, I can breathe—
then nothing else mattered
That heart of mine—
once more, go far, go far,
someone inside me sings
with a passion beyond all control
So that you, whose eyes were always swollen,
never have to grieve again, I can smile
a song to become that kind of hero
Farewell—raise it high, the peace sign
for this story as it tumbles along
'I want to protect you'—I could say that,
but I knew you weren't that weak
It was me who was weaker than that
you mattered that much to me
'I'll make it through life alone'—
from the day I shouted it out,
go ahead and laugh at how I've changed
at me, afraid of being alone
kick me, bite at me
I can't even breathe,
my head raging, the pit of my stomach
all crumpled up as it is—
until even pretense and showmanship fade away
right now I want to touch your heart
We will surely, someday,
reach even the sun, far as it is,
win the hour before dawn, and laugh
dyed in that blue-burning color,
toward the far side of the hazy town,
we should be able to run, hand in hand
with you, I'll steal a sketch of the future,
a story with no twists at all
Days scabbed over and worn rough,
a now ground down and scraped away—
your words bring them back to life
vividly, they come into view
The soul still sleeping in its chrysalis,
the dream left half-eaten and thrown away—
take them back once more
Once more, go far, go far,
someone inside me sings
with a passion beyond all control
So that you, whose eyes were always swollen,
never have to grieve again, I can smile
a song to become that kind of hero
Farewell—raise it high, the peace sign
for this story as it tumbles along
With you, I'll steal a sketch of the future,
a story with no twists at all
